title: LLM-assisted screening and extraction for systematic reviews: code and data
description: Code and data accompanying the article 'LLM-assisted screening and extraction for systematic reviews: performance and refusal-related missingness in a land-use evidence synthesis' (Environmental Evidence). Includes the screening and extraction workflow, the evaluation code, the supplementary four-model comparison, and the stored outputs needed to reproduce the reported tables and figures offline.
